'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Tom Hollingworth LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingworth]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tom Hollingworth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/worlds-2014-reset-beta-event-3rd-place-ls-tom-hollingworth-wys/ PC list]
